Request with all message role types (system, user, assistant, tool) to verify round-trip serialization

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:liter_llm/liter_llm.dart';
import 'package:liter_llm/src/liter_llm_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final req = await createChatCompletionRequestFromJson(json: '{"messages":[{"content":"You are a helpful assistant.","role":"system"},{"content":"What is the weather in Paris?","role":"user"},{"content":null,"role":"assistant","tool_calls":[{"function":{"arguments":"{\\"location\\": \\"Paris, France\\"}","name":"get_weather"},"id":"call_xyz789","type":"function"}]},{"content":"{\\"temperature\\": 18, \\"unit\\": \\"celsius\\", \\"description\\": \\"Partly cloudy\\"}","role":"tool","tool_call_id":"call_xyz789"}],"model":"gpt-4"}');
    final apiKey = Platform.environment['API_KEY'];
      if (apiKey == null || apiKey.isEmpty) { throw StateError('API_KEY must be set'); }
      final client = await LiterLlmBridge.createClient(apiKey);
    final result = await client.chat(req: req);
    stdout.writeln(result.choices);
    stdout.writeln(result.choices[0].finishReason);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
